concerns.text: The plan reports per‑predictor significance p‑values (FR‑013) derived from linear‑model coefficients but states no multiple‑comparison correction is needed because the primary outcome is R². Reporting individual predictor p‑values without correction constitutes a methodological flaw; each predictor test inflates Type I error. Either apply a suitable correction (e.g., Bonferroni, Benjamini‑Hochberg) or clearly label these as exploratory without inferential claims.
